items.title: MECH-440 legs (ii)/(iii): state-conditioning + self-annealing second-order falsifier (armed raised-floor stack, ANNEAL vs NO_ANNEAL ablation)
items.note: Routed by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-955_2026-08-29 (confirmed, user-ratified 2026-08-29; ratified again at /governance same day, session governance-20260829-mac), section 7: "Routing: /queue-experiment, NEW EXQ for state-conditioning + self-annealing (per-state noise-magnitude covariance with state; per-parameter sigma trajectory vs policy confidence), on the same armed raised-floor stack. Explicitly NOT a 955a same-question re-run." 955 confirmed MECH-440 leg (i) PROPAGATION only (secondary_checks_measured=false in its own manifest); legs (ii)/(iii) were never measured anywhere in the corpus. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readouts (per-tick A0_OFF-referenced raw_score_range paired with lever-arm divergence, stratified by seed-median; ARM_ANNEAL-vs-ARM_NO_ANNEAL differential divergence suppression by stratum) recorded nowhere in the corpus -- not recoverable by reanalysis -> run. A0_OFF is NOT reused from 955 despite being config-slice-identical and reuse-eligible there: this driver's yoked pass needs a LIVE jointly-stepped A0_OFF agent, which the arm-reuse mechanism cannot supply. Step 2.5b re-derive brake: 0 substrate_ceiling-category autopsies for MECH-440 (955 resolved MEASURES FAILED, an adjudication-branch defect, not substrate_ceiling) -- NOT braked. Step 2.5c substrate-path overlap gate: same two OPEN corrupting substrate_queue entries as 955 (mode-governance-engagement, contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy) carved out per 949/955's identical precedent. DESIGN: 3 arms (A0_OFF / ARM_ANNEAL / ARM_NO_ANNEAL, the anneal-flag-only ablation of 955's ARM_NOISE_SINGLE), same matched armed-conversion stack, class floor raised to action_dim, same P0=100/P1=50 phased training, P2=100 yoked episodes. 955's ARM_TEMP dropped (propagation already confirmed, not re-tested). Seed 44 swapped for 48 (955's autopsy diagnoses 44 as a coupled near-saturation anomaly on this env/floor; avoided for a first measurement of the new per-tick stratification instrument). FIXES 955's own driver-fix note: the ceiling-headroom precondition now MEAN-aggregates (not max) across seeds. TWO LOAD-BEARING CRITERIA: C_STATE (leg ii, operationalized as impact concentration -- ARM_ANNEAL's divergence from A0_OFF concentrates in near-tie (low raw_score_range) states, not raw bias-magnitude covariance, which is close to tautological given the noise head's linear dependence on candidate features within a fixed-eps tick); C_ANNEAL (leg iii, causal ablation -- ARM_ANNEAL suppresses divergence in DECISIVE states relative to ARM_NO_ANNEAL while near-tie-state rates stay comparable, i.e. selective not uniform decay). PASS requires BOTH on >=2/3 of >=4 eligible seeds; one-of-two reads as mixed, naming which leg confirmed. VACUITY RULE unchanged from 955/949. SMOKE: --dry-run PASS on ree-cloud-1 (this box lacks torch; ree-v3 CLAUDE.md "Running the test suite" routing applied by proxy for a single smoke run over ssh). validate_experiments.py --strict clean (0 warnings after adding MIN_STATE_PAIRS to the config_slice). INSTRUMENT CONTROL self-yoke divergence = 0.000000 for all 3 arms. state_stratification instrumentation confirmed live (33 genuine (raw_score_range, diverged) pairs collected on a 3-episode/25-step dry-run, exceeding MIN_STATE_PAIRS=30 threshold behavior at the intended scale). estimated_minutes calibrated from 955's own measured elapsed (13.1h on ree-worker-1, same arm count/seed count/P0/P1/P2 budget), +modest margin for the added per-tick bookkeeping.

items.title: MECH-144: ventral-analog spatially-graded valence gradient probe
items.note: EXP-0459. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (pearson correlation of HARM_DISCRIMINATIVE valence vs ground-truth distance-to-hazard, sampled continuously in P2) not recorded anywhere -- V3-EXQ-375/V3-EXQ-165 (existing MECH-073/MECH-143/MECH-144-adjacent runs) carry no per-step raw data and no substrate_hash (pre-standard); not recoverable -> ran fresh. Substrate readiness: MECH-144 carries no v3_pending/implementation_phase gate; SD-014 valence mechanism (ree_core/residue/field.py) already built+validated by V3-EXQ-375. ARC-040's dorsal/ventral module SEGREGATION is V4-scoped but MECH-144 itself only asserts spatial valence encoding, tested here via the single V3 ResidueField/RBF valence map as the undifferentiated ventral-analog approximation. Distinguishes MECH-144's graded/anxiety-cell-style prediction from V3-EXQ-375's binary-discrimination AUROC design and from V3-EXQ-165's navigation-robustness DV.

items.title: MECH-143: dorsal CA1 value-free map probe (goal-value-change vs goal-location-change discriminative pair)
items.note: EXP-0058 (Duvelle et al. Curr Biol 2019 analog: place fields are geometrically stable and insensitive to reward-value change at a fixed goal location). MECH-143 was untested (evidence: [] in claims.yaml) and depends_on ARC-007/MECH-073/Q-020, all of which are implemented substrate (ARC-007 hippocampal path memory + HippocampalModule/ResidueField, MECH-073 valence-in-map-geometry via SD-014, Q-020 Resolution A splitting value/wanting (z_goal, REEAgent.update_z_goal) from the ResidueField/z_world map HippocampalModule navigates, SD-005). No v3_pending/implementation_phase gate on MECH-143. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout (cosine-distance drift of z_world snapshots at fixed probe positions, pre/post a goal-value-only vs goal-location-only manipulation) is not recorded in any existing manifest -- V3-EXQ-375 (MECH-073) and V3-EXQ-800 (ARC-007) are the closest precedent but neither snapshots z_world at fixed positions before/after a value-vs-location manipulation, and pre-2026-07-12 manifests carry no substrate_hash anyway -> not recoverable, ran fresh. Step 2.5b re-derive brake: 0 substrate_ceiling-category autopsies tag MECH-143 (first run ever) -- not braked. Step 2.5c substrate-path overlap gate: checked substrate_queue.json for open corrupting entries touching ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py, ree_core/latent/stack.py, ree_core/residue/field.py, ree_core/agent.py (update_z_goal/sense) -- none found. DESIGN: 2 arms, matched seeds, CausalGridWorldV2.reset_to() deterministic scripted-eval placement (SD-029/EXQ-433a pattern) for both training episodes and an 8-position probe grid; VALUE_CHANGE holds hazard+resource cells fixed for the whole run and raises env.resource_benefit (0.20->1.00) at the P1A/P1B boundary (raw observations at every probe cell are bit-identical pre/post by construction, so any drift is attributable only to value-differentiated weight drift -- the exact channel MECH-143 makes a prediction about); LOCATION_CHANGE holds resource_benefit constant at 0.20 and instead relocates the resource cell at the same boundary (the positive control: raw observations genuinely differ, proving the probe is sensitive to real structural change). DV-symmetry-invariance (CLAUDE.md /queue-experiment Step 3): VALUE_CHANGE's map_drift is NOT null-by-construction (no symmetry makes it trivially zero -- a nonzero reading is a genuine, not vacuous, finding of weight-level value leakage); LOCATION_CHANGE is deliberately not invariant (positive control). Pre-registered thresholds (C1 VALUE_CHANGE map_drift<0.20, C2 LOCATION_CHANGE map_drift>0.35, C3 paired per-seed ordering LOCATION>VALUE, PASS=C1 AND C2 AND C3, >=2/3 seeds each) are first-of-kind priors with no prior V3 measurement of this probe to calibrate against -- flagged as a real calibration risk, not silently treated as authoritative; a FAIL on C2's absolute threshold with C1/C3 holding would be worth a follow-up recalibration rather than an immediate claim demotion. Non-degeneracy guard: each cell's PRE-snapshot cross-probe-position dispersion must clear 0.02 (check_degeneracy on zworld_probe_dispersion), else that cell's low map_drift reading is representation-collapse, not evidence. SMOKE: --dry-run PASS on ree-cloud-1 (this dispatch box has no torch; ree-v3 CLAUDE.md test-suite routing applied by proxy -- ran in a throwaway detached worktree off HEAD, dry-run manifest correctly relocated to /tmp/ree_dry_run_manifests/ by emit_outcome(dry_run=True), nothing landed in the shared evidence/ tree, worktree + scratch files removed after). All 6 cells (3 seeds x 2 arms) completed without crash; [train] ep N/M, Seed/Condition boundary, and per-cell verdict lines all present; z_goal_stream diagnostic reads writer_calls=646>0, ticks_active=0 (correctly wired, benefit gate simply never opened at dry-run's 3-episode/15-step scale) -- no writer defect. As expected at dry-run scale (9 of 180 real episodes, mostly P0 warmup), PRE-snapshot dispersion was near the degeneracy floor in all 6 cells (map is essentially untrained); this is not informative about the real run and is exactly what P0=60 warmup exists to fix. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 non-conforming, 0 warnings.
